title: Improved approximation algorithms for capacitated cluster editing
abstract: arXiv:2611.05916v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the minimum-disagreement cluster editing problem that, from a complete edge-signed graph, where a positive edge represents two vertices agreeing to each other while a negative represents a disagreement, constructs disjoint cliques of upper bounded size such that the total number of negative edges inside cliques and positive edges outside cliques is minimized. When the sizes of the candidate cliques are unbounded, the problem is NP-hard and APX-hard, and many approximation algorithms with improving ratios have been proposed in the literature and the state-of-the-art approximation ratio of $\alpha = 1.3865 + \epsilon$. The capacitated variant, in which the candidate cliques have sizes no greater than a given $k$, is less studied and the best approximation ratio is $5.37$. In this paper, we study the latter problem. tldr: 本文针对带容量约束的聚类编辑问题，提出了一种缩减程序，将最佳近似比从 5.37 改进到 $\alpha_k = 2\alpha + 1$（约为 3.773）。
en_tdlr: This paper presents improved approximation algorithms for the capacitated cluster editing problem by introducing a downsizing procedure that improves the best approximation ratio from 5.37 to $\alpha_k = 2\alpha + 1$ (approximately 3.773).
